items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And then there was Dick Wilson

ctx.x: Let's spend some time with these three years when you were in high school playing high school dates. What kind of things do you remember about that period? What kind of development took place? You said things got a little heavier.

Well, even way back then I realized that I wanted to have a sound, because...listening to Herschel, listening to Ben and I heard some things by Coleman Hawkins in a music store...and I wasn't aware of him, because I'd heard Chu Berry and I loved him. And I became involved in sound. Chu Berry and, of course, Lester and Herschel and...they were on the radio all the time and everybody in the country was playin' tenor saxophone. You either played like Herschel or you played like Chu Berry or Lester Young, in those…
